notes.title: Skill Tree & UI Module Update! V1.07
notes.content:
[b]Skill Tree Overhaul![/b]

[b]• Skill Pages Reworked:[/b]

Redesigned [i]Skill Learning[/i], [i]Active Skill Setup[/i], and [i]Passive Skill Setup[/i] pages in the game menu.

All skills are now displayed using [b]skill icons[/b].

Skills require [b]prerequisite unlocks[/b] before learning the next one.

[b]• Active Skill Page:[/b]

Equip quick access skills for combat.

[b]• Passive Skill Page:[/b]

View and manage passive skills, active effects, and detailed effect entries.

Passive skills can now be activated in two different ways: Skill Equip Mode and Auto-Activation Mode. In Auto-Activation Mode, the skill takes effect automatically once the player acquires it. In this mode, the same character can have an unlimited number of passive skills activated simultaneously.

[b]UI Module Updates[/b]

[b]• Character Info Module:[/b]

Reworked character status UI in the game menu.

[b]• Detailed Stats Page:[/b]

Displays [i]temporary effects[/i], [i]abnormal resistances[/i], etc.

Old static data panel has been removed.

[b]• New Event - Overlay Message Box:[/b]

Displays a [b]focused message[/b] in the center of the screen.

One message shows at a time; the next event starts when it ends.

[b]• Dialog Improvements:[/b]

Portrait positions are now configurable.

Full preview of dialog effect available based on current settings.

[b]• Custom UI Enhancements:[/b]

Quest tracker now supports [b]auto-tracking[/b] a number of quests.

Manual quest tracking available via the quest menu.

Fixed issues with [i]variable bar visibility[/i].

Added [b]default images[/b] for game menu buttons.

Character speech bubbles now show [b]smaller, refined text[/b].

[b]• Visual & Message System Enhancements:[/b]

Improved visual feedback for [i]status effects[/i], [i]combo counters[/i], and [i]damage numbers[/i].

Message popups now support [b]3 messages at once[/b]; excess messages enter a queue.

Updated [i]default quest and story icons[/i]; old icons moved to internal map resources.

More [b]end icons[/b] now available for message systems.

Fixed [b]HP bar text scaling issues[/b] at different font sizes.

[b]• RPG/SRPG Battle Menu Updates:[/b]

Fully redesigned battle UI, logic, and skill/item preview systems.

Added [i]quick skill access[/i], [i]tile-based effects[/i], and better enemy feedback in SRPG mode.

[b]Map Updates[/b]

Added [b]“Function – Fast Travel Landing Point”[/b] for precise fast travel positioning.

Added [b]“Function – Battle”[/b] to trigger combat when touched.

Objects now support [b]custom collision sprites[/b] via “Image – Object Collision Mask”.

Editor can now [b]show collision masks[/b] for map objects.

[b]Dialogue Editor Updates[/b]

Streamlined UI for easier use.

Displays [i]default language data[/i] to assist localization.

Improved preview font clarity; fixed [b]blurred outlines[/b].

[b]Editor Enhancements[/b]

[b]Image Filters:[/b] Toggle visual filters in [i]Basic Settings – Image Settings[/i].

Added [b]Rough Pixel Mode[/b] for large pixel block visuals.

Hitbox animations now support [b]glow effects[/b] at night.

Variable setting now allows [b]random value ranges[/b].

UI updated across component editors and windows.

Improved layouts for [i]Map Structure[/i], [i]Key Settings[/i], and [i]effect/skill selectors[/i].

[b]Engine Updates[/b]

[b]Dodge Formula Adjusted:[/b] Slightly increased evasion rates.

[b]Passive Skill “Persist” Updated:[/b]

Removed max trigger rate.

Now [b]guaranteed to trigger[/b] under HP threshold.

180s cooldown, resets after rest.

[b]New Passive Entries:[/b] (Triggered by Persist)

Super Armor

HP Regen Over Time

Invincibility

[b]Effect Adjustments:[/b]

“Enlarge” / “Shrink” affect hitbox size and jump height.

Improved [i]ground texture tiling[/i].

Upgraded [i]camera tracking logic[/i].

[b]RPG / SRPG Combat Features:[/b]

Quick skill menu added.

SRPG now supports [b]Auto-Battle[/b].

Show [i]real damage and accuracy[/i] when targeting.

Camera zoom via mouse wheel.

Camera movement via mouse drag.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed [i]SRPG knockback tile error[/i].

Fixed [i]Clone effect tile occupation bug[/i].

Fixed DEBUG mode bugs (hitbox toggle, forced combat).

Fixed [i]item deletion pagination[/i] in menu.

Fixed [i]texture element issues[/i].

Fixed [i]text display bugs[/i].

notes.title: Trap Update! V1.05
notes.content:
[b]Trap System Update![/b]
Added 33 new trap components!
New types include: Laser, Trigger Vine, One-Time Trigger Spikes, Speed Boost Panel, Conveyor Belt, Spiked Wall.
Removed the "Style" option from traps. New traps will now be directly added to the component tab.

[b]Map Updates:[/b]
Added the following to the "Function" tab:
Default - Variable: Allows variables to be changed, enabled, or disabled continuously through character triggers.
Default - Main Story: Allows main story text to be changed through character triggers.
Default - Battle: Forces a battle to start through character triggers. Characters on the map can be selected to join the battle.
Item: Place pre-edited items on the map.
Event: Place pre-edited events on the map. Events can be executed through character triggers.
Quest: Place pre-edited quests on the map. Quest status can be changed through character triggers.
Money: Now supports placing money directly on the map using new money icons or sprites.
Increased the number of built-in assets for "Public Facilities."

[b]Map UI Updates:[/b]
Replaced the original NPC sprite images.
Some map component tabs now display their names.
Hovering over map items displays their contents.

[b]Editor Updates:[/b]
Fixed a bug causing Android builds to fail on startup.
Updated the UI for some components.
Fixed the undo function in drawing mode.
Users can now export long strip PNGs of parts from "Resources - Character Art Templates" and "Resources - Paper Dolls" for external editing.
Fixed a bug where item properties couldn't select variables in item settings.

[b]Engine Updates:[/b]
The camera now automatically adapts to widescreen (21:9) resolutions.
Added icon display for money and special statuses.
Fixed an issue where variable bars wouldn't display in custom UIs.
Added Z-axis collision to vehicles.
Added default sound effects to some objects.
Fixed display issues with overly long button text.
Fixed a bug where scrollbars wouldn't display in some menus.
Modified some default UIs.
Fixed a bug where arrows wouldn't display correctly in options.
Adjusted the trigger mechanism for ground cracks.

notes.title: Spring Festival Update 1.04
notes.content:
[b]Custom Portrait Feature is Now Live![/b]

[b]Template Management:[/b]
Users can now edit, copy, add, and create new templates through "Resources - Portrait Templates."
New elements can be added to basic portrait templates.
Character Appearance:
Portrait templates can now be assigned to characters via "Character - Appearance Settings."
Doll materials are no longer bound to portrait templates, allowing for more flexibility.

[b]Trap Updates:[/b]
Trap Adjustments
Trap mechanics have been revamped, with four new trap types added for testing:
Strike Trap
Bear Trap
Hidden Arrow
Falling Hammer
Additional Features:
Added trap size adjustments.
Fixed a bug where trap shadows were always visible.
Redesigned turret projectiles and spring functionality.

[b]Map Editor Enhancements:[/b]
Added trap movement directions and trigger range settings to the editor.
Map Updates
Spring Festival Decorations:
Added several Spring Festival-themed objects to the map editor.
Light Source Changes:
Light sources are now disabled by default.
Characters can activate light sources by entering their trigger range.

[b]Editor Updates:[/b]
Added an option to enable the "PIXEL GAME ENGINE" game startup screen.
Introduced a color picker for the color palette.
RGB Values Display: The color palette now shows the current color’s RGB values.
Updated functionality for character part components.

Happy Chinese New Year!

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
[b]Map Feature Updates![/b]
Slope Replaces Stair Platform:
The "Stair" component has been updated to "Slope."
Slope Adjustments: Customize slope height to change its gradient. Optional railings are available; characters within the railings will not fall.
Ruler and Alignment: Added measurement tools for slopes and platforms to help with alignment and positioning.
Direct Object Selection: Objects can now be selected directly by clicking, regardless of their elevation from the ground.

[b]Event Updates![/b]
Three new events have been added:
Game Parameter Settings: Adjust game parameters during gameplay.
Soundtrack Menu: Open a music playlist in the game to play all or unlocked tracks.
Menu Options: Open a UI options menu in-game. The menu includes option descriptions displayed at the bottom of the screen.

[b]Arcade Mode Updates![/b]
Countdown Timer: A countdown function has been enabled.
Classic Arcade UI Option: Added a classic arcade-style UI.
Coin Sound Effect Option: Added the ability to enable or disable coin insertion sounds.
Character Selection: Players can now choose whether duplicate character selections are allowed.
Score Display: Game scores are now synchronized and displayed during gameplay.
Timer Adjustments: The countdown timer limit and time bonus cap have been increased to 999 seconds.
Bug Fixes: Addressed several issues within arcade mode.

[b]Action and Hitbox Updates![/b]
Collision-Based Attack Destruction:
Added an option for attacks to be destroyed upon collision with solid objects such as walls or terrain.

[b]Battle UI Updates![/b]
Enemy Health Bar Option: Added the ability to display health bars for enemies.
Customizable Health Bar Settings: Adjust the alignment and length of health bars in the character UI module.
Character Selection Updates: Improved functionality for character selection.
Boss Health Bar Display: Enabled a feature to display Boss health bars.

[b]Dialogue Feature Updates![/b]
Added 11 new comic-style bubble box images.
Added animation effects for bubble dialogue boxes.
Added 7 new information window images.
Added 8 new comic-style dialogue box images.

[b]Editor Updates[/b]
Updated character part selection functionality.
Optimized scroll bar adjustments and improved mouse wheel support.
Fixed various popup-related bugs.

[b]Engine Updates[/b]
Data Structure Optimization: Enhanced the performance and efficiency of data handling.
Collision Interaction: Added interactions between map objects and characters during object movement.
Battle UI Integration: Enemy health bars now use the settings from the Battle UI module.
Texture Fixes: Resolved a bug related to horizontal texture mapping.

notes.title: Autumn Important Update
notes.content:
[b]Custom Model Feature Update[/b]
Paper Doll Models: Moved to the resource manager. Users can view, edit, import, and export both built-in and custom models in the resource list. Both built-in and custom models now support creating new model skins.

[b]Special Effect Keywords[/b]
Expanded Keywords: Increased from 15 to 121 special effect keywords, including freeze, petrify, silence, paralysis, and more, suitable for all game modes.
Keyword Settings: Duration, activation probability, buff/debuff values can be configured. Includes built-in animations for effects.
Trigger Methods: Effects can be activated via items or skill animations, enabling diverse combinations for unique gameplay outcomes.

[b]Built-in Asset Updates[/b]
Expanded Assets: Added assets for platforms, obstacles, streetlights, billboards, public facilities, and switches.
Tree Assets: Default trees now include animation effects. Tree order and sizes have been adjusted for better screen adaptation.

[b]Skill Updates[/b]
Passive Skills Revamp: Over 50 new passive skill types added, including:
"Damage Conversion"
"Full-State Buffs"
"Empty-State Buffs"
"Block/Kill Buffs"
"Attack Poisoning"
Skill Categories:
Attack: 18 new types
Defense: 18 new types
Utility: 13 new types
Status Effects: 18 new types, now integrated into passive skills.
Custom Animations: Active skills now support custom model animations.
Target Options: RPG mode skills now allow targeting self, random enemies, in addition to single and group targets.
SRPG Enhancements: In SRPG mode, if a skill’s combo is set to "auto," the character will automatically execute the combo with the corresponding skill's attack range.

[b]Character Function Updates[/b]
Custom Animations: Added 10 customizable animation slots for each character, which can be triggered via events or object interactions.
Energy Burst Effects: 29 new animation effects, adjustable via "Character Settings > Appearance" or "Event Settings > Adjust Appearance."
Drop Immunity: Added immunity settings for equipment drops.

[b]Animation Function Updates[/b]
Particle Effects: Now available for use in actions and hit settings, under "Effects > Particle Effects" and "Hitbox > Style > Hit Animation Effects."
Effect Reorganization:
"Apply Effects" and "Crowd Control" split from original hit effects.
Effects like knockback and knockdown are now under "Crowd Control."
Buffs now support full special effect keywords.
Hitbox Adjustments: Revised hitbox dimensions for self-hit effects.

[b]Audio Updates[/b]
New Sound Effects:
Item pickup and usage
Quest success and failure
Dialogue text pop-up sounds
Character-Specific Sounds: Configure individual characters with attack, hit, skill, and death sound effects.

[b]Event Updates[/b]
New Event Features:
Display UI Images: Render images on the UI layer via events.
Item/Skill/Quest Cards: Display detailed information for items, skills, or side quests.
Set Respawn Points: Overwrite player respawn locations through events.
Editor Enhancements: Event editor now shows starting/ending events, branch count, and more.

[b]Item Function Updates[/b]
Effect Integration: Item effects now support the full range of special effect keywords.

[b]Map Updates[/b]
Special Terrain: Replaced the "Water" tab with "Special Terrain." Objects in this tab offer unique in-game functionalities.
Map Text: Drag-and-drop text or numbers onto maps via "Effects > Map Text."
In-Scene Teleportation: Added functionality to teleport players to specific positions without map transitions.

[b]Editor Updates[/b]
Skill Icons: Added 100 new icons.
Animation/Visual Effects Tab: Moved some animation-related settings and added damage display options.
UI Enhancements: Improved UI layout and component aesthetics.
Dropdown Menus: Simplified option selection with new dropdown menus.
Improved Usability: Added titles and enhanced menus for better aesthetics and functionality.

[b]Game Engine Updates[/b]
Massive UI Overhaul: Comprehensive improvements to all UI elements, including menus, combat UI, animations, button effects, item and list displays. Updated font styles and UI text rendering.
Resolution Settings: UI resolution can now be adjusted under "Basic Settings > UI Settings > Menu UI Settings." Changes affect both built-in and custom UI elements.
Custom UI Enhancements:
Turn-based combat UI editor.
"Quick Item Bar" and "Item Switch Bar" for toggling consumables, equipment, and key items via keyboard/controller shortcuts.
Combat Improvements:
Added quick skill functionality in RPG and SRPG battles.
Auto-battle mode in RPG combat, with cancellation option.
Other Features:
Boss health bar settings.
Enemy and NPC equipment functionality.
Improved AI for real-time combat characters.
Optimized damage display.
Fixed various bugs, including traps not triggering and SRPG battle camera issues.

notes.title: Android Packaging Feature Begins Testing
notes.content:
[b]Release Note 0.99L:[/b]

[b]Android Packaging Feature Begins Testing[/b]
Instructions for Developers:

Developers need to download the corresponding SDK and set the runtime library path. When the path displays as "Ready," it indicates the path is correct.
Developers can download the SDK files through the provided links.
Currently Tested SDK Versions:

Android SDK (34.0.0) Stable Version
Java JDK (11.0.0.2)
Note: Higher versions of Java JDK may cause issues with package signing.
Shader Performance Notice:
Some shaders may perform differently on Windows and Android platforms.

[b]Basic Android Packaging Process:[/b]
Create a Keystore File
Set Android Display Name, Version, Icon, and Package Information (Format: domain.company.product, e.g., com.pixelmonsters.pixelgameengine)
Create the APK File

[b]Known Issues[/b]
Only the official version of Android SDK can be used, not the RC version. Do not select the RC version when installing the SDK. You may also install the latest version of NDK.
The password of the keystore file must be 8 digits or more
Packaging the apk file into a Chinese folder may cause packaging to fail
If packaging fails, try packaging the apk into the root directory of the disk

Added screen virtual button functionality and options.
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Mid-May Minor Update
notes.content:
This update fixes some bugs and adds the following features:
Map Editing Redesign: Added two new 3D textures.
Perspective System Fix: Fixed the perspective system for the ground, and corrected the editing logic for platforms, air walls, and stairs.
New Event "Real-Time Map Switching": Developers can switch maps in real-time without using transition effects.
Character Running "Always Run": The default movement mode for players is now running.
Map Editing Flexibility: Any icons can now be used in map editing, not just map-specific icons.
Background-Ground Texture Options: The ground background can now be set to either tile or stretch textures.
Custom Paper Doll Enhancements: Weapons and accessories can now be customized for paper dolls.

notes.title: Spring Update (Important)
notes.content:
Attention: This update brings numerous changes, some of which may affect your current game projects. If this update results in incomplete text display or other issues in your project, please carefully review the update announcement or actively contact us.

The main contents of this update include:

Added support for 6 languages, including Russian, Thai, Korean, Arabic, Italian, and Portuguese.
Moved bug reports to the GitHub platform.
Modified event execution logic. The event logic in single-chip mode has been removed, and a free-form event logic is now adopted. Users can freely arrange events and choose branches for event outcomes.
Adjusted the female character model and updated animations for built-in female character models. (This may affect animations currently in use)
Updated tutorial DEMO. The old Demo may not work properly, please re-import the new demo for use.
More video formats is supported, now developers can use .avi, .mp4 files to play in the game.
Optimized the storage and loading scheme for imported images, allowing the use of a greater number of images without worrying about loading delays.
Redesigned the engine UI, dialogue UI, and information bar.
Added CRT display mode.
Added 12 visual effects, including dark, dizzy, monitor, underwater, etc. (Can be used with filters)
Added 12 built-in mini-games, including dice, cards, buttons, unlocking, etc.
Added check events for judgment.
Added various camera events, including camera effects, dynamic effects, and visual effects.
Added various customizable UI elements, including network images, variable bars, task tracking, etc.
Fixed font display issues in the editor and engine.
Added scaling functionality for dialogue boxes, character portraits, and information bars.
Added customization of background images for game menus.
Added editing functionality for random NPC name databases.
Added variable control events, allowing continuous value changes for variables and triggering events based on values.
No longer support X86 platform.
Fixed some bugs.

Editor updates:
Redesigned editor UI. Users can now customize the editor's color scheme according to their preferences.
Modified some feature layouts.
Added customizable value ranges for variables.
Added display of character interface ability values.
Added dialogue box preview.
Modified object placement logic in map editing. Objects can now only be placed within ground range and can adjust their height by dragging or holding SHIFT.
Redesigned animation and action event editors, adding more shortcut keys for animation editing to significantly reduce production time and difficulty.
Added functionality to display previous and next frames for animations.

Engine updates:
Added built-in UI skins, button skins, and dialogue box skins.
Optimized fonts.
Added default transition effect selection.
Added menu effects.
Modified default menu layout.
Enhanced visual effects for menu UI.
Added built-in system languages.
Added 4-directional walking functionality.
Added more message prompts for numerical changes.
If your game fails to display correctly with the new features, you can find the "appdata/Local/PixelGameEngine/Common/lang/game_lang.csv" file and import it into "Multilingual Management-Import System Text" to display it correctly (will overwrite the original file).

notes.title: Important notes about the upcoming Update
notes.content:
Dear users, 
Becauses we have  the core of engine upgraded, there will be some changes that affect your current projects.
1. The engine will no longer support X86 platform of windows.
2. The current event system(State-machine Style) will be changed to "Mind map" style, you don't have to do any changes necessary. The new system will still be able to run the old event system, but you will have to manually change your events if you are using the new event system.
3. There will be upgrades to the built-in resources. The built-in animations, especially. If you are going use the upgraded animations you will have to re-import these to your project.
